skills.name: search-jobs
skills.description: Find live curated tech jobs by keyword, type, or location via MCP tool search_jobs or GET /api/jobs?q=. Supports cursor pagination (next_cursor). No auth.

skills.name: get-job
skills.description: Fetch full detail for a single curated job by id via MCP tool get_job or GET /api/jobs/{id}.

skills.name: platform-stats
skills.description: Live counts of jobs, companies, and profiles on CVin.Bio via MCP tool platform_stats.

skills.name: verify-public-profile
skills.description: Check whether a person has a public CVin.Bio profile page at https://cvin.bio/{username} with schema.org Person markup.

skills.name: tech-news
skills.description: Recent ranked items from tier-1 tech RSS sources via GET /api/news?limit=20.
